integrity: Analytic proof of the quantified theorem; a reproducible symbolic checker supports algebra but does not replace the proof. Publication-priority searches were best-knowledge and access-limited. No independent validation claimed.

title: A sharp gain-two limit to stability rescue by symmetric sampling jitter
